--- README ---
# Self-Improving AI

This system is designed to automatically produce agents for solving downstream tasks. The system iteratively improves the generated agents through code editing. To enable continuous improvement, the system should look at its code repository and the provided path to previously generated agents and their evaluation results, and then edit and enhance its own mechanisms for generating agents. This process creates a recursive loop of self-improvement.

# ARC-AGI-2 domain

Each task has a few demonstration pairs (`train`: list of `{"input": grid, "output": grid}`) and one
or more test inputs. A grid is a rectangular list of rows of integers 0-9 (at most 30x30).

## Task agent interface
`task_agent.py` must define `TaskAgent(model=..., chat_history_file=...)` with
`forward(inputs) -> (prediction, msg_history)`, called once per test input with
`inputs = {"domain": "arc", "train": [...], "test_input": grid}`.
`prediction` is a list of up to 2 candidate output grids (a single grid is also accepted).
